name: Oddsfish!
desc: Benson's Restoration novel of 1914, told by Humphrey Challoner, a young Catholic in the court of Charles II: the king's secret reception into the Church, the Popish Plot and the intrigues of Whitehall.
desc_pt: O romance de Benson sobre a Restauração (1914), narrado por Humphrey Challoner, jovem católico na corte de Carlos II: a recepção secreta do rei na Igreja, a Conspiração Papista e as intrigas de Whitehall.
srcnote: Parts and chapters as printed; the numbered sections inside chapters are kept as ## headings.
